steps.what: Flag a blank rule on the operations record
Monitor operations against safety rules
Decide environmental policies and government regulations
Sign the compliance decision
File the signed compliance decision
outputs: filed copy of signed compliance decision v1

tasks.design: A job flags an operations record whose rule identifier or document field is blank. The manager monitors operations in person, including safety rules, contracts, and regulations. A later job files the signed decision in {DOCS}. The flag does not decide compliance, and it does not score a person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rule fields were opened one by one to see which were empty.
tasks.enabler_now: The rule identifier is already on the record.
tasks.still_hard: A complete record can still fail on the floor.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides whether the operation complies.
tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the floor, not on finding blank fields.

reach.task: Act only on the signed decision

evidence.claim: The executive digest says receipts, purchase-order policy and tariff checks are rules, and a person handles a mismatch.
Digest [S10] says no significant decision about a person is made solely by automation.
Digest [S14] says works-council consent covers staff data and monitoring.

assumptions: Rule identifier, document field, and shipment identifier are stored on the operations record. The operations record produces them. A blank field is flagged and is not treated as compliant.
Native configuration of the operations record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
The job does not monitor named staff. Consent for monitoring is a separate decision.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining watch time is still the manager on the floor.

incremental.description: Refresh rule identifier and document field when the operations layout changes, and drop a flag the manager has not reviewed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes rule identifiers are often blank. The high end assumes rule identifier and document field are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze the impact of logistics changes.

steps.what: Sum stored product volumes by mode
Analyze the financial impact of logistics changes
Decide routing, shipping modes, and carriers
Sign the impact decision
File the signed impact decision
outputs: filed copy of signed impact decision v1

tasks.design: A job sums stored volumes, mixes, and rates by mode and carrier in {ERP}. The manager analyzes the financial impact of the proposed change and decides the routing. A later job files the signed decision in {DOCS}. The sum is not the decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Volume totals were rebuilt before each proposal.
tasks.enabler_now: Volumes and rates are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: A lower total can still be the wrong route.

ambition.what: Decide a routing change the week the volume is stored.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the change, not on the sum.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a cost-to-serve figure is plain code on stored quantities and rates.

assumptions: Volume, mode, carrier, and rate are stored on the ledger. The ledger produces them. A blank rate is not summed and is shown as a gap.
Native configuration of the ledger is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining analysis time is still the manager deciding the change.

incremental.description: Refresh volume, mode, and carrier when the ledger layout changes, and drop a total the manager has not accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes a carrier has no stored rate. The high end assumes volume, mode, and carrier are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Flag materials below the stored minimum
Monitor inventory levels in the warehouses
Decide which products need a reorder
Sign the inventory decision
File the signed inventory decision
outputs: filed copy of signed inventory decision v1

tasks.design: A configured check in {ERP} flags materials below the stored minimum. The manager monitors the warehouse levels and decides any reorder. A later job files the signed decision in {DOCS}. The flag does not place an order.
tasks.previous_blocker: Levels were scanned by hand against a minimum.
tasks.enabler_now: On-hand quantity and the minimum are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: A short item can still be one the manager will not reorder.

ambition.what: Decide a reorder the week the level falls under the minimum.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the exceptions, not on reading every item.

reach.task: Order only from the signed decision

evidence.claim: The executive digest says logistics planning is configured route and stock tools, and the manager decides.

assumptions: Item identifier, warehouse, on-hand quantity, and minimum are stored on the ledger. The ledger produces them. A blank minimum is not flagged as short.
Native configuration of the ledger is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining watch time is still the manager on the stock.

incremental.description: Refresh item identifier, on-hand quantity, and minimum when the ledger layout changes, and drop a flag the manager has not seen.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes minima are often blank. The high end assumes item identifier and minimum are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Count stored on-time and damage events
Establish supply chain measurement systems
Monitor specific performance of those systems
Sign the measurement system
File the signed measurement system
outputs: filed copy of signed measurement system v1

tasks.design: A job counts stored on-time and damage events in {BI}, using only a measure definition that is already stored. The manager establishes the supply chain measurement system and monitors it. A later job files the signed system in {DOCS}. The count is not a score of a person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Event totals were rebuilt before each review.
tasks.enabler_now: The events and the measure definition are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: A worse on-time figure can still be the right measure to keep.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides which measure stays.
tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the measure, not on counting events.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says logistics planning is configured route and stock tools, and the manager decides.
Digest [S11] says allocation or performance scoring of people is Annex III point 4(b).
Digest [S12] says those duties apply from 2 December 2027.

assumptions: Event type, shipment identifier, and measure definition are stored on the report record. The report record produces them. A blank definition is not counted.
Native configuration of the report record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
The count covers shipments, not named staff. Performance scoring of people is not this job.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time is still the manager establishing the measure.

incremental.description: Refresh event type and shipment identifier when the report layout changes, and drop a count the manager has not accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes measure definitions are blank. The high end assumes event type and the measure definition are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The distribution manager spends the week on the floor, the exception, and the signed decision. A stored quantity times a stored rate, a rule on a document field, and filing that decision can move. The manager still directs people and still inspects the warehouse.
reach: A warehouse lead follows only the assignment the manager signed.
A carrier is told only the rate the manager signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a list that is missing a stored field.
Reject a procedure sentence that has no stored row.
role.ambitious_version: A signed operating decision can be filed the same week, and the manager still owns the floor.
